subject: OTLP bridge pilot & co-sell workshop — Datadog + Grafana
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Leclerc <sophie@datadog.com>, Mateo Ruiz <mateo@grafana.com>
Cc: Ilya Petrov <ilya@observify.io>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: OTLP bridge pilot & co-sell workshop — Datadog + Grafana

Hi Sophie and Mateo,

Thanks again for the intro, Ilya. Redwood would like to propose a short technical pilot to validate an "OTLP bridge" pattern: customers send OTLP to Redwood, we fan out a normalized stream to Datadog and Grafana (metrics + traces + lightweight logs), with an experimental agentless ingest path so customers can avoid installing the Datadog agent for cloud-native apps.

High-level ask:
- 4-week technical pilot with one joint customer (we nominate the candidate)
- 90-minute enablement + co-sell workshop week 1 (engineering + solutions)
- Shared SOW for engineering work to configure mappings, dashboards, and a fallback routing policy

I attached a short spec (OTLP-bridge-spec-v1.pdf) and a draft workshop agenda. If this is interesting, can we target week of Apr 26 for the workshop? Availability windows below.

My availability (PST): Apr 26–28 midday (11:00–15:00). Please propose a time that works for both teams.

Primary goals for the workshop: align on OTLP schema mapping, retention & metric cardinality guardrails, dashboard ownership, and co-sell story.

Thanks — happy to run the first agenda and circulate a brief mutual action plan afterwards.

Best,
Ben Carter
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
(attachment: OTLP-bridge-spec-v1.pdf)

From: Sophie Leclerc <sophie@datadog.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mateo Ruiz <mateo@grafana.com>
Cc: Ilya Petrov <ilya@observify.io>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 12:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: OTLP bridge pilot & co-sell workshop — Datadog + Grafana

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear summary and the spec. Datadog is interested; a few quick clarifying items before we lock the workshop slot: 

1) For agentless ingest, do you expect NDJSON logs over OTLP or OTLP/native logs? We need to confirm our parsing paths.
2) Metric cardinality: will Redwood perform any pre-aggregation or do you expect Datadog to do cardinality control on ingest?
3) For authentication, is the plan to use short-lived API keys per-tenant or to route via a Datadog relay?

We can do Apr 27 at 12:30 PM PST for the 90-minute session — Mateo, does that work for you?

I attached some onboarding notes that might speed the pilot.

Cheers,
Sophie Leclerc
Partner Engg, Datadog
sophie@datadog.com
(attachment: datadog-onboarding-notes.pdf)

From: Mateo Ruiz <mateo@grafana.com>
To: Sophie Leclerc <sophie@datadog.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ilya Petrov <ilya@observify.io>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 13:18:00 +0200
Subject: Re: OTLP bridge pilot & co-sell workshop — Datadog + Grafana

Hi all — Grafana Labs on board. A couple of notes from our side:
- For dashboards, we'd like to pre-seed a Grafana folder with templated panels that map to the OTLP metric names you define.
- On traces, we prefer sampled parent-child semantics preserved (so keep trace IDs intact).
- We'll need a short section in the SOW for licensing/metrics export to avoid double-billing customers if both Datadog and Grafana are billed for the same metric stream.

Apr 27 12:30 PM PST works for our eng and solutions folks. Looking forward to the pilot.

Regards,
Mateo Ruiz
Strategic Partnerships, Grafana Labs
mateo@grafana.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Sophie Leclerc <sophie@datadog.com>, Mateo Ruiz <mateo@grafana.com>, Ilya Petrov <ilya@observify.io>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OTLP bridge pilot & co-sell workshop — Datadog + Grafana

Internal note / ask for the Redwood side:

Thanks team — confirmed workshop Apr 27 12:30 PM PST. Actions for Redwood before the workshop: 
- Laura: spin up the sample OTLP payloads and include an example mapping for histogram -> Datadog distribution metric (see OTLP-bridge-spec-v1.pdf).
- Karthik: draft a simple auth pattern (short-lived API key per tenant + rotate) and include a fallback relay option.
- Jordan: prepare the demo customer (we discussed Acme Cloud as a candidate) and validate that they can expose OTLP endpoints. Ilya will help coordinate on the consulting front.

Attachments: I pushed a draft SOW to drive and attached a co-sell agenda. Please review by EOD Apr 14 so I can send the SOW to Datadog/Grafana for legal review.

Ben

From: Sophie Leclerc <sophie@datadog.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mateo Ruiz <mateo@grafana.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OTLP bridge pilot & co-sell workshop — Datadog + Grafana

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Two items before we wrap: 

1) Datadog legal asked for a short SOW clause around data retention and PII handling. We attached a marked-up SOW (SOW-draft-Redwood-Datadog-Grafana.pdf) with our suggested language.
2) For the pilot customer, Acme Cloud looks fine. Sophie (Datadog) + Mateo (Grafana) will run a 30-min pre-flight with them on Apr 23 to validate OTLP endpoints and credentials.

Next steps: Ben to incorporate the SOW redlines; Redwood to confirm pre-flight schedule and finalize co-sell slide for the workshop.

Best,
Sophie

--
Sophie Leclerc
Partner Engg, Datadog
